name: Hourray: Automatic Time Tracker & Focus Timer
notes: Hourray 1.9: tracking checked to the minute and over 25 counting fixes; a focus timer (Classic 25/5, Deep 50/10, Flow); it stops counting after a quiet stretch you choose and asks what the time was; pause for 15 minutes, an hour or until tomorrow; don't track a site in one click; attach a link, a PDF or picture, or a note to any line; exports as PDF, spreadsheet or .md; a year of history; a new look.
